title: Tamed Mount: Jabberwock
text: Mount Grand Grand Ferocious Jabberwock Enemies remember old nightmares when a jabberwock joins the fray. The Tamed Jabberwock has the following skills: Lv10: Run!Run!Mana 20Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Pet Move Speed +50% for 10sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv20: Desperate EscapeDesperate EscapeInstant5sec CooldownIncreases the mount’s Move Speed +65% for 1sec, then gradually decreases to -30% for 4 seconds. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Right-click to activate auto-use. Lv50: Uncontrollable MoveUncontrollable MoveInstant1min 30sec CooldownThe Jabberwock is running out of control for 10sec. Can't use while carrying a trade pack. or Vicious BiteVicious BiteInstant18sec CooldownStrikes a distant target, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and an additional (varies) damage over 14sec. Can't be used while charging, airborne, or carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount.
